item.title: By: Ron
item.dc:creator: Ron
item.content:encoded:
I guess we have all been arseholes and will be again. Judgement is a sanctuary of sureness. Being sure is shoring up against a tsunami we could instead swim with and in. We could join everything in the swim; we will be swimming anyway even if we look away.

As to arseholism we will do it again – we can bear witness to our arseholism, acknowledge it, be sorry for it, offer compassion for it and try again.

item.title: By: Raquel
item.dc:creator: Raquel
item.description: So interesting and touching the list I've just read. I think one of the first steps towards becoming 'less asshole' is to become more aware of our own personal limitations and illusions. I've been trying to practice mindfullness meditation for a while now, and one thing I've learned is that I need to be more skeptical of my opinions and certainties. By reading the list, I realized how much I need to work on to become a better person. Thank you for this memo.
item.content:encoded:
So interesting and touching the list I’ve just read. I think one of the first steps towards becoming ‘less asshole’ is to become more aware of our own personal limitations and illusions. I’ve been trying to practice mindfullness meditation for a while now, and one thing I’ve learned is that I need to be more skeptical of my opinions and certainties. By reading the list, I realized how much I need to work on to become a better person. Thank you for this memo.
